question: The Patkai hills are part of the __________ mountains.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Purvanchal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Patkai hills** are part of the **Purvanchal mountain range**, located in the northeastern region of India.
 
• The Purvanchal range includes the **Patkai hills, Naga Hills, Mizo Hills, and Manipur Hills**.
 
• These hills are part of the **Eastern Himalayas** and are characterized by their **rugged terrain** and **dense forests**.
 
• The Patkai hills form a natural boundary between **India and Myanmar**.
 
• The range is known for its **rich biodiversity**, including rare species of flora and fauna.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the climatic conditions of the region, contributing to **heavy rainfall** and a tropical climate.
 
• Several tribes inhabit the region, and the area is known for its unique **cultural heritage** and traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Western Ghats**__

 __
 
• The Western Ghats are a **mountain range** located in western India, running parallel to the Arabian Sea.
 
• They are known for their **UNESCO World Heritage Sites** and **rich biodiversity**.
 
• The region is home to several **national parks**, **sanctuaries**, and **reservoirs**.
 
• Major rivers such as **Godavari, Krishna, and Kaveri** originate from the Western Ghats.
 
 
 
• **Eastern Ghats**__
 __
 
• The Eastern Ghats are a **discontinuous range of mountains** located along the eastern coast of India.
 
• They are older than the Western Ghats and are characterized by **eroded hills**.
 
• Important rivers like the **Mahanadi, Krishna, and Godavari** cut across the Eastern Ghats.
 
• Major peaks include **Araku Valley** and **Mahendragiri Hills**.
 
 
 
• **Karakoram**__
 
 
• The Karakoram is a **mountain range** spanning Pakistan, India, and China.
 
• It contains some of the world’s **highest peaks**, including **K2**, the second-highest peak in the world.
 
• The **Siachen Glacier**, the world’s second-longest glacier outside the polar regions, is located here.
 
• The region is known for its **extreme climatic conditions** and rugged terrain.
